title: Reading Drill — Labels at the City Market
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Labels at the City Market
passages.body:
**A** At a city market, a survey found that shoppers often asked sellers whether prices referred to one item or a whole bag. The market team created a common layout which put the unit price on the same line as the item name.

**B** The layout worked well for fruit and vegetables but caused difficulty at a second-hand stall. Its volunteer seller often negotiated prices, so she used a blank space for the final amount instead of printing it in advance.

**C** After a month, traders were asked whether the new sign altered their sales. The most consistent change was not sales but shorter queues, possibly because fewer people needed to ask the same question before paying.
